name: stack-health
description: Status dots above the prompt for your Docker Compose services and any local ports you name.

ports.title: Ports to watch
ports.description: Comma-separated local ports or name=port pairs, e.g. web=5173,api=3000.

compose.title: Watch Docker Compose
compose.description: Show the services of the docker compose project in the working directory.

githubOnly.title: Only in GitHub repositories
githubOnly.description: Show this bar only when the session folder is a git repository whose remote is on GitHub. Turn off to show it in any git repository.
